kicker: LEDGER · Monday 5 October · phase 0, the sweep
title: What existed that nobody looked at
how: Everything the project has made was checked against the main copy. Two things need you: the September map of the town, which shapes the town, and tidying away old copies. Tap a picture to see it full size.
foot: The full report is in the project's audits folder (the sweep of 5 October). Anything you do not pick carries onto the next page.

sections.name: The September map: make it the town's map?
sections.note: Drawn 22 September and never brought in. It names canon's seven districts and puts Quay Street and Mickey's where the built street has them. Shown as drawn then: a few labels overlap the roads.

pictures.alt: Meridian: seven districts, main routes, landmarks; 200 m scale
Quay Street in the Hook: Mickey's at the quay end, the fish shop next, shops across the north half
Daily routes, escape lines and sightlines between the districts (ideas, not yet in the game)

options: Keep it as a reference only
sections.detail: If you say yes, this map becomes the one place the town's layout is kept, and the built street is checked against it. Two differences are already known: the built street is 48 m long with the chandler's, the map's 42 m; and the built road bends and climbs at the far end. Left out either way: its design of Mickey's as a pub and the bars and beer in its drawn mood pictures, which break the content rule and your ruling that Mickey's is the cab office.

sections.name: Tidy away 68 old copies of work, each kept as a snapshot?
sections.note: All 68 are already in the main copy, are older versions of it, or held research reports that are now copied in. Each stays as a labelled snapshot, so nothing is lost and any can be brought back.
